summary: NULL dereference in a calibration path (crash, core, backtrace)
issue:
sensor_report crashes on the QNX target since we added the humidity sensor (humid2) to sensors.cfg:

    # ./sensor_report sensors.cfg
    Memory fault (core dumped)

humid2 has no calibration table yet. Sensors without a calibration table should be reported with their raw average and the "(uncalibrated)" marker, as the README says; the other sensors must be reported exactly as before. We built it with `make` in task/sensor_report and copied sensor_report and sensors.cfg to /tmp on the target.
